newsitem.title: UK: ManUtd up, Sunderland down on latest results.
newsitem.headline: ManUtd up, Sunderland down on latest results.

text.p: Manchester United Plc shares rose on Monday as the club's victory on Saturday took it closer to another league championship, while Sunderland tumbled after a heavy league defeat.
Manchester United shares were up 8p at 645 by 1035 GMT while Sunderland was down 35p at 617-1/2. Trading volume in both stocks was thin at 15,203 and 9,735 shares respectively.

Manchester went three points clear at the top of the premier league after a 2-0 victory over Sheffield Wednesday while Sunderland dropped to 15th position, three places away from the relegation zone, after a 6-2 hammering by Chelsea.
Chelsea Village shares were up 3p at 131-1/2 though no trading was recorded in the stock.
